_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency audit policy (scripts/qa/audit-policy.mjs). A waiver needs a reason, an owner and an expiry; an expired waiver fails the build. Remove a waiver as soon as a patched version exists.

waivers.reason: Only reachable through @expo/cli → @expo/code-signing-certificates, i.e. the developer/CI build tooling for the mobile app (EAS CLI, Expo Go code signing). It never runs in the API, the web app or inside the shipped mobile binary. No patched node-forge release exists yet.

Stack-exhaustion denial of service on deeply nested glob patterns, reachable only through Metro's file watcher (react-native → metro → micromatch) on a developer machine/CI that builds the mobile app, from patterns in our own repository. Not part of the shipped app or any server. No patched version exists yet.
